entities.name: Marie-Cécile Zinsou
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie-Cécile Zinsou is a French-Beninese art historian and entrepreneur. She is president of the Fondation Zinsou, founded in 2005 in Cotonou, Republic of Benin, which promotes contemporary art in Africa and leads cultural, educational and social initiatives. In 2014, she opened the first museum of contemporary art in Benin.
